sahityam.anupallavi: sOma bimba manOhara sumukhi sEvakAkhila kAma dAna nirata kaTAkSa vilAsini (amba)
sahityam.charanam1: pura vimata vadana pankEruha madhupE nArada mukha maunI nikara gEya caritE SarasIruhAsanAdi sura samudaya maNi cAru mauLi virAjita caraNAmbuja yugaLE
sahityam.charanam2: kanaka bhAsura divya kalApa rAjita gAtri vanaruha daLa darpa vibhanjana ruci nEtri munigaNa sammOhana mAnanIya mrduhAsE vinata jana kalpakavallari giri sutE
sahityam.charanam3: kuru mE kushalam sadA kamalanAbhAnujE niravadhi bhava khEda nivAraNa niratE cArunUtana ghana sadrusha rAjita vENi dAruNa danujALi dAraNa paTucaritE
